description: "查看细节，不丢掉来时的阅读位置。"

---

```{=html}
<div class="viewer-toolbar"><div class="viewer-filename" id="viewer-path">尚未选择文件</div><div class="viewer-actions"><a class="soft-button" id="open-original" href="files.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-native hidden>新窗口打开 ↗</a><a class="soft-button" id="download-file" href="files.html" download hidden>下载文件 ↓</a></div></div>
<div class="viewer-surface" id="file-preview" aria-label="文件预览"><p class="empty-state">正在读取文件…</p></div>
<p class="viewer-help" id="viewer-help">底部的返回按钮会回到来源笔记，并恢复阅读位置。</p>
<section class="viewer-backlinks" id="viewer-backlinks" hidden><div class="eyebrow">MENTIONED IN / 引用这个文件的笔记</div><div id="viewer-backlinks-list"></div></section>
```
